summary: QP-1 v1.5 follow-ups (reconciliation UI + history + dashboard dedup + persona-everywhere) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 new tests pass (persona fallback, reconcile match/no-match, 403 ownership, pacing.reconciled_total, history clamping 0→1 & 20→12, FY labels). Frontend: dashboard dedup verified (OJ-1 hidden, QP-1 visible), CSC-1 shows caregiver voice ('Is your parent on the right classification?'), CE-2 body carries 'your parent's income' copy, /app/pacing?tab=history renders 4 FY-aligned cards (Apr-Jun 2026, Jan-Mar 2026, Oct-Dec 2025, Jul-Sep 2025) each with envelope $6,682 + Underspent, /app/pacing?tab=week reconcile card toggle → form → submit → result flow works and disposition surfaces created_adhoc.

routes/qp1.py pacing_history: FY quarter walker is correct (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct starts) and clamps quarters into [1,12] ✅.
routes/persona.py _profile_from_user: fallback chain viewer_persona → user.role → caregiver works ✅. Verified cathy (no viewer_persona, role=caregiver) resolves to caregiver.
OJ-1 envelope tile dedup: hides when QP-1 schedules OR ledger entries exist — verified visually on cathy dashboard.

Prior iter86 code-review notes still apply: /qp1/pacing does verify ownership via _assert_owns_participant (fixed since iter86). /qp1/ledger list also enforces ownership ✅. auto_assume now requires participant_id + ownership check ✅ (matches routes/qp1.py:512-523).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seeded a TEST_Recon_Cleaning weekly schedule + several TEST_STMT_* reconciliation audit rows + one TEST ad_hoc entry from the unmatched line. Cleanup fixture ends the TEST_ schedule at teardown, but past ledger entries remain (by design — audit history).
